item.title: Dead Air RXD910Ti –New Suppressor in the RXD Series
item.description: There are few items as nice to have on your gun as a suppressor. The ability to shoot with reduced sound makes range time much more enjoyable. Add to that the improvement in felt recoil and muzzle rise, and suppressors are a winner. The nature of suppressors also allows them to work in multiple calibers. item.description: Several years ago, I had the opportunity to test-drive a new Barrett rifle. It was the first release of the REC 10, and it was a sexy, accurate, easy shooting beast. item.title: Shooting 101: Do Pistol Grip Safeties Make It Safer or a Liability?
item.description: Grip safeties on a pistol have been around since at least the introduction of the 1911 pistol, with at least one revolver using them in the late 1800’s. They still exist on most 1911 pistols today, as well as a few others. But do they make your pistol safer? Or are they a liability? item.title: SHOT 2026: ARs & AR Pistols
item.description: There were a variety of new ARs and AR pistols this year at SHOT Show. Many were chambered in 5.56 or 300 BLK, but a few new rifles were released in 6.5 Creedmoor, 300 Win Mag, .338 ARC, and a new caliber, .30 EPIC.
